name: Cashew Chicken with Jasmine Rice
description: Quick wok-seared chicken thighs with toasted cashews, celery, green pepper and a glossy sweet-savoury soy sauce, adapted from Joshua Weissman and served with jasmine rice
instructions: Cook jasmine rice in a rice cooker or saucepan.
Whisk together 1 tsp dark soy sauce, 1 tsp light soy sauce, 20 ml prepared chicken stock, 2 tsp rice vinegar, 2 tsp honey, 3/4 tsp cornflour and a pinch of black pepper until smooth.
Toast the raw cashews in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 5-8 minutes, stirring often, until lightly golden and fragrant, then set aside.

Season the chicken thigh pieces with salt. Heat 1 tsp neutral oil in a wok over high heat and sear the chicken for 6-8 minutes, turning often, until evenly browned and cooked through to 75°C. Transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining 1/2 tsp neutral oil to the wok. Stir-fry the spring onions for 1 minute until lightly charred, then add the roughly chopped garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds.

Add the diced celery and green pepper and stir-fry vigorously for 30 seconds. Return the chicken, stir-fry for another 30 seconds, then pour in the sauce. Bring to a boil and toss for about 25 seconds until thick and glossy. Fold through the toasted cashews and serve immediately.
